name: Supabase
description: SSR-safe browser/server/admin clients, Result-based storage helpers, server-validated auth via @supabase/ssr middleware, RLS examples, type generation, optional Drizzle ORM and realtime. When 'auth' is selected, ships a root middleware (refreshes the Supabase session + protects configured paths) and src/lib/auth/getCurrentUser+requireAuth — all honouring AUTH_MODE=mock as a dev short-circuit.

questions.prompt: Supabase anon key? (public — safe in the browser)
Which Supabase features? (storage and auth helpers are emitted when selected)
Add a Drizzle ORM layer over the Supabase Postgres connection?
Include the type-generation script (supabase gen types)?
Path prefixes the middleware should require auth for (comma-separated)? (only used when 'auth' is in features)

checklist: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from Project Settings → API
Set SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY — server-only, never prefix with NEXT_PUBLIC_ (it bypasses RLS)
Create storage buckets in the dashboard or via: supabase storage create <name>
If type generation is enabled: install the supabase CLI, add "gen:types": "bash scripts/gen-types.sh" to package.json scripts, then run yarn gen:types after supabase start + schema changes
Enable RLS on every table before going to production (see supabase/migrations/0001_example_rls.sql)
If Drizzle is enabled: npm install drizzle-orm postgres tsx (and -D drizzle-kit), add "migrate": "tsx scripts/migrate.ts" to package.json scripts, set SUPABASE_DB_URL, then yarn migrate

If 'auth' is in features: the emitted middleware.ts overwrites auth-mock's dev middleware, refreshes the Supabase session on every request, and redirects unauthenticated requests for paths under {protected_paths} to /login
If 'auth' is in features: import getCurrentUser / requireAuth from src/lib/auth/ in Server Components and Server Actions
Keep AUTH_MODE=mock for local dev — middleware and getCurrentUser() short-circuit to auth-mock's MOCK_USER
getCurrentUser uses getUser() (server-validated JWT); never authorize off getSession() locally
